cues.en: So, our goal in this section is to build a web interface to our chat application, okay, to our RAG-based application.
cues.zh: 這一章的目標，是為聊天應用程式，也就是以 RAG 為基礎的應用程式，建立網頁介面。

cues.en: And right now, if you look at CLI.py, okay, we have a means of chatting right here, okay.
cues.zh: 目前看看 cli.py，這裡已經有聊天功能。

cues.en: So, we have that ask, but we're going to ignore that one.
cues.zh: 雖然也有 ask，但這次先不看它。

cues.en: We're going to look at this one, chat.
cues.zh: 我們要看的是 chat。

cues.en: This allows us a terminal-based chat.
cues.zh: 它提供終端機裡的聊天功能。

cues.en: And although we're going to implement a web-based chat, it's going to call the same functions that you see this particular command calling.
cues.zh: 雖然接下來要實作網頁聊天，但仍會呼叫這個指令使用的相同函式。

cues.en: Nothing about retrieval, embedding, ingestion, or the prompt builder, nothing is going to change.
cues.zh: 檢索、嵌入、匯入與提示建構器，全都不需要改動。

cues.en: We're just putting an HTTP shell over top of this, okay.
cues.zh: 只是替現有功能加上一層 HTTP 介面。

cues.en: So, this is the second time that our abstractions pay off.
cues.zh: 這是抽象設計第二次發揮價值。

cues.en: The first one was when we switched from Postgres to Weaviate, and now we're going to switch from the terminal to the web.
cues.zh: 第一次是從 Postgres 切換到 Weaviate，現在則是從終端機切換到網頁。

cues.en: But our base code, the things that do the heavy lifting, they don't change at all, okay.
cues.zh: 但真正負責核心工作的底層程式碼完全不變。

cues.en: So, what we're going to do here now is add some necessary dependencies.
cues.zh: 現在要加入一些必要的相依套件。

cues.en: And I've picked ones that will do the trick for us.
cues.zh: 我挑選了幾個能滿足需求的套件。

cues.en: So, since we're going to be using a web application, we're going to need a few things over here in pyproject.toml, which is at the root level of your project.
cues.zh: 既然要建立網頁應用程式，就需要在專案根目錄的 pyproject.toml 裡加入一些項目。

cues.en: And we're going to go to the block named project right here, and we're going to add a few things.
cues.zh: 到這裡名為 project 的區塊，新增幾個相依套件。

cues.en: So, right after Weaviate, we're going to add a really commonly used one, fastAPI, okay.
cues.zh: 在 Weaviate 之後，加入非常常用的 fastapi。

cues.en: And we'll make that greater than or equal to 0.110.
cues.zh: 版本設為大於或等於 0.110。

cues.en: That will absolutely do the trick.
cues.zh: 這個版本就能滿足需求。

cues.en: And this will give us our API roots, simple enough, okay.
cues.zh: 它會提供 API 路由，很簡單。

cues.en: Now we're also going to add uvicorn, and then in square brackets, I'm going to put standard, okay, which will do the trick.
cues.zh: 也加入 uvicorn，並在中括號裡寫 standard，這樣就夠用了。

cues.en: This is our web server, and that's greater than or equal to 0.27, and then a comma.
cues.zh: 這是我們的網頁伺服器，版本大於或等於 0.27，最後加上逗號。

cues.en: And I'm also going to want to add, from here, python-multipart to allow us to upload files, okay.
cues.zh: 另外加入 python-multipart，讓我們能上傳檔案。

cues.en: So, I'm going to import python files, greater than or equal to 0.0.9, and there might be a later version, but this will do the trick.
cues.zh: 加入這個套件，版本大於或等於 0.0.9。可能已有更新版本，但這個版本就足夠。

cues.en: And later on, we'll be working with images, so I'm going to import this right now, just to save some time later on, Pillow with a capital P, okay, greater than or equal to 10.0, and my trailing comma, okay.
cues.zh: 後面還會處理圖片，所以現在也先加入 Pillow，P 要大寫，版本大於或等於 10.0，最後加上逗號，省得稍後再處理。

cues.en: Now I'll open my terminal, I'll clear the screen, and from the root level of my project
cues.zh: 接著開啟終端機，清除畫面，並在專案根目錄下，

cues.en: while in my virtual environment, I'll say pip install-e dot, and that should go and
cues.zh: 確認已啟用虛擬環境後，執行 pip install -e .，它應該就會

cues.en: get the necessary dependencies for me. And it's done. Perfect.
cues.zh: 替我們安裝必要的相依套件。完成了，很好。

cues.en: Okay, so now that we have our dependencies installed, it's time to start writing some code.
cues.zh: 現在相依套件已安裝完畢，該開始寫程式了。

cues.zh: 繼續往下吧。
